faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do I get started with your services?
faq.a1: Just send us a message through the contact form or email us directly. We'll schedule a quick call to understand your needs and propose the best solution.
faq.q2: How long does it take to get a response?
faq.a2: We typically respond within 24 hours, often much faster during business hours.
faq.a3: Pricing depends on the scope — we offer both fixed-price source code packages and custom project quotes after a short consultation.
faq.q4: Do you work with international clients?
faq.a4: Yes, we work with clients across the US, Vietnam, and worldwide, with flexible communication across time zones.
